differences.openwhisper: An application-wide event filter adopts any stylesheet set on a widget at its StyleChange event as the designed source and resolves its tokens and font sizes at once.
differences.fiorivoce: Widgets set token sheets through setLocalStyleSheet, which stores the source and resolves it; a lint forbids raw setStyleSheet in ui_* code, and a sheet set directly anyway is adopted as source at the next theme or scale change.
differences.reason: One resolution pass per theme change and no filter on every widget's StyleChange.
